title: Practice 7: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Это за ___ (дополнительная плата, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **плата → плату** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  **дополнительный → дополнительную** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with плату). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. плата · платы · плате · плату · платой · плате; pl. платы · плат · платам · платы · платами · платах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: И в нем перуны скрыв, в нощи привесть под ___ (град, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **град → град** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. град · града · граду · град · градом · граде; pl. грады · градов · градам · грады · градами · градах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Они за ___ (живот, acc. pl.) хватались, хохоча над его шуткой.
exercises.prompt: They held their sides with laughter at his joke.
exercises.why: **живот → животы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural животы. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  Declension: sg. живот · живота · животу · живот · животом · животе; pl. животы · животов · животам · животы · животами · животах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Положу деньги под ___ (закладная, acc. sg.) дома из десяти процентов.
exercises.why: **закладная → закладную** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. A noun that declines like an adjective (an adjective used as a noun): it takes adjective endings, not noun endings. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. закладная · закладной · закладной · закладную · закладной · закладной; pl. закладные · закладных · закладным · закладные · закладными · закладных.  «Больной, раненый and знакомый are often used as adjectival nouns.» — DLI, Lesson 57.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я буду вынужден уволить Вас за ___ (систематическое опоздание, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: I will have to fire you for consistent tardiness.
exercises.why: **опоздание → опоздания** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural опоздания. Declines like DLI's здание — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. здания). Ending -е → -я.  **систематический → систематические** (acc. pl., agreeing with опоздания). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. опоздание · опоздания · опозданию · опоздание · опозданием · опоздании; pl. опоздания · опозданий · опозданиям · опоздания · опозданиями · опозданиях.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Все они под ___ (одна стать, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **стать → стать** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's часть — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **один → одну** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with стать). «один» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (f. sg.): одна · одной · одной · одну · одной · одной.  Declension: sg. стать · стати · стати · стать · статью · стати; pl. стати · статей · статям · стати · статями · статях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
